name: ArchonMusic
description: A professional Telegram Music Player Bot built with Python, Pyrogram, and Py-TGCALLS.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID. Get it from https://my.telegram.org.

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash. Get it from https://my.telegram.org.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot Token. Get it from @BotFather.

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection URL. Get it from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

LOGGER_ID.description: Telegram Log Group ID. Add the bot to your log group and promote it as an administrator.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram User ID of the person who should be assigned as the bot owner.

SESSION.description: Pyrogram v2 String Session. Generate one using @StringFatherBot on Telegram.
